question: A metal surface is illuminated separately by two beams of the same frequency but different intensities, both above threshold frequency. According to the experimental observations, compare the maximum kinetic energies of emitted photoelectrons. Justify your answer.

options.A: Both beams produce the same $K_{\max}$ because $K_{\max}=h\nu-\phi_0$ depends on frequency and the metal, not intensity. The higher-intensity beam only produces more photoelectrons per second.
options.B: The higher-intensity beam produces photoelectrons with greater $K_{\max}$ because intensity increases photon energy.
options.C: The lower-intensity beam produces greater $K_{\max}$ because fewer photons share the energy.
options.D: No photoelectrons are emitted at different intensities because the frequency is the same.
